verdict.language_detail: MATLAB (serial communication, MPU sensor data plotting)
verdict.provenance_detail: Student lab script for reading MPU accelerometer/gyroscope data over serial COM port and plotting calibrated/uncalibrated sensor data
verdict.purpose: Reads accelerometer and gyroscope data from an MPU sensor via serial port (COM3), performs calibration offset correction, scales raw values to physical units, and generates multiple plots comparing calibrated vs uncalibrated data for both accelerometer and gyroscope axes.
